{
  "dataset_name": "pima_diabetes",
  "model_family": "tree",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "glucose_risk_tier",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal bucket of plasma glucose: 0=missing/low(<70), 1=normal(70-99), 2=prediabetic(100-125), 3=diabetic(126-199)",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "glucose",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Direct ordinal split on clinically meaningful glucose thresholds; strong predictor of diabetes",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(plas < 70, 0, np.where(plas < 100, 1, np.where(plas < 126, 2, 3)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "bmi_category",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "WHO BMI category: 0=underweight/missing(<18.5), 1=normal(18.5-24.9), 2=overweight(25-29.9), 3=obese(>=30)",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "bmi",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Ordinal obesity indicator; obesity is a key diabetes risk factor enabling clean tree splits",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(mass < 18.5, 0, np.where(mass < 25.0, 1, np.where(mass < 30.0, 2, 3)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "glucose_bmi_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Product of glucose risk tier and BMI category capturing joint metabolic risk",
      "value_range": [0, 9],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Nonlinear interaction between two strong predictors; tree can split on combined metabolic burden",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(plas < 70, 0, np.where(plas < 100, 1, np.where(plas < 126, 2, 3))) * np.where(mass < 18.5, 0, np.where(mass < 25.0, 1, np.where(mass < 30.0, 2, 3)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_pregnancy_burden",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction of age and number of pregnancies normalized by mean age; captures cumulative reproductive stress",
      "value_range": [0, 25],
      "feature_family": "reproductive_history",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures compounded risk from multiple pregnancies at older age; nonlinear interaction for tree splits",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(preg * np.maximum(age - 21.0, 0.0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "insulin_glucose_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of insulin to glucose; proxy for insulin resistance when both are non-zero",
      "value_range": [0, 10],
      "feature_family": "insulin_resistance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures insulin sensitivity; high ratio may indicate hyperinsulinemia; tree can split on resistance threshold",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((plas > 0) & (insu > 0), np.clip(insu / (plas + 1.0), 0, 10), 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "missing_metabolic_flag",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Count of zero-coded missing values across glucose, BMI, blood pressure, skin, insulin (0-5); zeros likely represent missing data",
      "value_range": [0, 5],
      "feature_family": "data_quality",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Missingness pattern may correlate with health-seeking behavior and disease severity; tree can split on count",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(plas == 0, 1, 0) + np.where(mass == 0, 1, 0) + np.where(pres == 0, 1, 0) + np.where(skin == 0, 1, 0) + np.where(insu == 0, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "pedigree_risk_tier",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal bucket of diabetes pedigree function: 0=low(<0.2), 1=moderate(0.2-0.5), 2=high(0.5-1.0), 3=very_high(>=1.0)",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "genetic_risk",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Discretizes continuous genetic risk score into actionable tiers for tree splits",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(pedi < 0.2, 0, np.where(pedi < 0.5, 1, np.where(pedi < 1.0, 2, 3)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_risk_tier",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Age grouped into risk tiers: 0=young(21-29), 1=middle(30-44), 2=older(45-59), 3=senior(60+)",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "age",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Age is a strong diabetes risk factor; ordinal buckets enable clean tree splits at clinical thresholds",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(age < 30, 0, np.where(age < 45, 1, np.where(age < 60, 2, 3)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_glucose_obese_flag",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Boolean flag: 1 if glucose>=126 AND BMI>=30 (diabetic glucose + obese BMI combination)",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Boolean indicator of highest-risk metabolic combination; enables direct tree split on joint condition",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((plas >= 126) & (mass >= 30.0), 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "skin_bmi_deviation",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute deviation of skin thickness from expected value given BMI (using linear approximation skin~0.7*BMI); captures adiposity inconsistency",
      "value_range": [0, 70],
      "feature_family": "body_composition",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures unusual body fat distribution patterns; deviations may indicate metabolic abnormalities",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((skin > 0) & (mass > 0), np.abs(skin - 0.7 * mass), 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "overall_metabolic_risk_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Holistic metabolic risk score (0-10) integrating glucose level, BMI, age, pedigree, and pregnancy history into a composite risk estimate. Higher scores indicate greater diabetes risk based on clinical knowledge of risk factor interactions.",
      "value_range": [0, 10],
      "feature_family": "composite_risk",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a single composite risk axis that tree can split on; captures domain knowledge not easily expressed in single formulas",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "insulin_secretion_adequacy",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Assessment of insulin secretion adequacy (0-4) given glucose level: 0=adequate response, 1=borderline, 2=impaired, 3=severely impaired, 4=likely deficient. Based on whether insulin level is appropriate for the observed glucose concentration.",
      "value_range": [0, 4],
      "feature_family": "insulin_resistance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures physiological relationship between insulin and glucose that simple ratio misses; enables tree splits on insulin secretion patterns",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
